tasks.short: Read charts and compute camera ratios

steps.what: Read charts and collect camera, lighting and measurement inputs
Compute ratios and camera variables from checked formulas
Check calculated lighting, shutter angles and distances against shot requirements

tasks.design: Use a native camera calculator in {OTHER}, a camera calculation tool, for fixed formulas and unit conversions. Keep chart selection, measurement and visual checking human; the tool produces recommendations rather than changing camera controls.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual arithmetic and unit conversion interrupt setup decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Established formulas can be configured and tested without a model.
tasks.still_hard: The correct formula and chart depend on equipment and intended image.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when a technically valid setting fails the shot's visual purpose.
tasks.altitude: Less arithmetic, with unchanged control over camera choices.

reach.task: Compare exposure assumptions with a lighting setup

evidence.claim: Fixed camera ratios and unit conversions are suitable for a configured calculator; local savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary ends at checked setup recommendations; physically positioning equipment and shooting retain separate time.

Operator in s1 captures camera and lens model, selected chart/version, frame rate, relevant shutter or exposure values, filter factor, measured distances and units. The calculator runs only formulas whose required fields are present; missing or ambiguous inputs return to manual chart work in s1.
Formula authoring and test cases are implementation work; ongoing formula checks are counted below. There is no assumed sensor feed.
Test a native calculator first. Existing calculator runtime earns no labour saving.
research_questions: How much manual arithmetic remains after input capture and final setup checks?

already_counted.description: Chart selection, field capture and contextual checking

incremental.description: Check formula versions and equipment changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+25=60, gross=40, focal upkeep=6, net=34. Range 0-12 assumes recurring manual calculations; existing native calculation yields no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather verified broadcast facts and define script purpose and timing
Write new scripts for broadcasts from the checked material

loop.input: Verified source packet, audience, format and duration brief
loop.output: Script with source references and unresolved facts marked
loop.check: Writer checks every factual statement, implied meaning, spoken tone and realistic duration against sources
loop.stop: One draft and revision; unsupported passages return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative structure and spoken wording require language judgement

steps.what: Revise scripts for story, delivery and production requirements

tasks.design: Test native drafting support in {DOCS} using a bounded source packet. The writer verifies meaning and revises the script before handing a proposal to the producer; broadcast approval and playout stay outside this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: First-draft wording consumes time after facts are gathered.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded language draft can suggest structure and phrasing from supplied material.
tasks.still_hard: A script can mislead through framing even when individual facts are correct.
tasks.human_edge: Editorial judgement, voice and understanding of the production.
tasks.altitude: More attention to story and delivery, with unchanged publication authority.

reach.task: Discuss script pacing against programme timing

evidence.claim: Bounded drafting of a broadcast script is plausible, but neither accuracy nor local labour saving is established by the supplied editing cases.

assumptions: Boundary ends at a script proposal; producer editorial approval, fact acquisition by others and broadcast execution retain their existing time.

Writer in s1 gathers sources and captures source ID, date, relevant passage, verified names, audience and duration. Missing facts are researched manually within s1 or left unresolved; there is no free structured facts service.
Native document drafting is checked first. Transcription and rough-cut capabilities are not treated as evidence of script-writing savings.
research_questions: Does a blinded script trial save time after factual and framing corrections?

already_counted.description: Source capture, meaning checks and final script revision

incremental.description: Maintain drafting constraints and review examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=25+50*0.65+25=82.5; gross=17.5, focal upkeep=7, net=10.5. Range 0-4 assumes source-complete routine scripts; substantial editorial rewriting removes the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Interpret studio production needs and design graphics with visual and technical checks

tasks.design: Retain creative design and studio-format checks in the graphics editor in {OTHER}. Check existing native templates for repeated graphics before proposing a separate generator; this task establishes no recurring template workload.
tasks.previous_blocker: Visual communication and studio constraints vary with the production.
tasks.enabler_now: Graphics editors already support creation; no additional labour reduction is established here.
tasks.still_hard: Readable, coherent graphics must fit the production and technical output requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Judging visual hierarchy and how graphics will appear in the actual programme.

reach.learn: Studio graphics design and output constraints

evidence.claim: Without a measured recurring template subtask, creative studio graphics work supports no assumed labour reduction.

assumptions: Boundary ends at a graphics proposal, excluding producer approval and live playout.
Producer supplies brief and studio specifications; operator interprets them during s1. No machine assumes structured graphic content or verified rights fields.
OTHER is a graphics editor. Native templates should be tested first if recurring variants are observed.
No new system or capture obligation means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Is there a repeated variant production step distinct from visual design?

already_counted.description: Design and visual and format checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Existing editor runtime and unobserved template tasks create no savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read trade magazines to stay current

steps.what: Read trade magazines and assess new technologies against production experience

tasks.design: Keep reading and critical interpretation human, with current publications accessible through {DOCS}. Test native publication search if retrieval becomes a distinct burden; replacing reading with summaries does not demonstrate equivalent learning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Understanding technical changes requires attention and comparison with practical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital access improves availability without proving reduced learning time.
tasks.still_hard: Separating marketing claims from useful and compatible technical developments.
tasks.human_edge: Relating claims to actual production constraints and experience.
tasks.altitude: Learning responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss compatibility of a new camera feature

evidence.claim: Critical reading is retained because summary generation alone does not establish equivalent technical understanding.

assumptions: Boundary is operator reading and interpretation; acquisition, purchasing and equipment trials are separate.
Publishers supply articles; operator selects and interprets them in s1. No structured relevance feed or automatic technology assessment is assumed.
Use native publication search first if a retrieval issue is observed.
No new tool or data maintenance means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Actual time spent locating rather than reading articles
research_questions: Is retrieval a separate repeated burden, and does changing it preserve learning?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=0 and upkeep=0, net=0. Learning is retained and no additional digest-writing baseline is invented.

role.altitude: Keeps visual and technical judgement while testing fixed calculations and bounded script drafting.
reach: Discuss exposure calculations with lighting technicians and script timing with producers
role.ambitious_version: A camera operator who spends more setup time on image quality and production intent.
